name: Knowledge and RAG Foundation Pack
description: A governed foundation for building source-traceable, access-aware, refreshable knowledge bases and retrieval-augmented AI systems.

sources.authority: Only sources approved by their accountable owner and rights reviewer

retrieval_guidance: Apply identity and access filters before retrieval; preserve provenance and version metadata; rank only authorized candidates; cite the exact supporting source; distinguish evidence from inference; abstain or escalate when evidence is missing, conflicting, stale, inaccessible, or outside scope.

refresh_policy.cadence: Owner-defined scheduled review plus event-driven updates for changed or revoked sources

quality_owner: AI AuthoriTech knowledge-quality owner or the named client delegate
